stopped_items: Read 2's ±15 STOP fired: 166 regressed bills against the expected 47 + 42. Every one of the 78 extra bills passed on a House suspension, which D2 itself counts as passage. I asked Craig, and he chose to backfill all 166 (2026-10-03 ~02:00 UTC). It was not worked around.

D1's advance rule, as written, ranks failed (90) above enacted (80), so a failed status could never be superseded. Prod shows every federal failed is a MINT artifact, and 6 bills read enacted only because the old overwrite rescued them. Craig chose to add clause (c): signed/veto_overridden/enacted beat failed/withdrawn/tabled. The rest of D1 is built as written.

The Senate arm of the D2 vote-path advance is built but inert. Every Senate roll stores vote_result '' (1,893 of 1,893 on prod), so no Senate passage roll can be recognised as passed, and the backfill excludes the 58 bills whose only evidence is a Senate 'On Passage of the Bill' roll. The tree contradicts the prompt's premise ('the result in votes.metadata.vote_result :948'), so this is filed as FIX-1260 rather than fixed here. Fixing the read alone would make every agreed-to Senate cloture motion mint passed_chamber (FIX-1261).

D3(a) as specified ('Motion to reconsider…' → status_held 1) cannot hold under D1. That text now maps to null and is never sent, so held stays 0. Case (a) asserts that instead, and a sibling case (a') covers a real hold: 'Received in the Senate and … referred to' → in_committee, held 1.
